classified: test/factory/*.t.sol — the source-version suites needed for the factory pilot, at the top level of the directory only
test/deployed-factories/FusionFactoryEthereum.t.sol — unchanged deployed-usage coverage for the Ethereum pilot
scope.unclassified: Everything else under test/, including test/factory/price_feed/ and any other file under test/deployed-factories/, is deliberately not classified yet. An unlisted suite carries no claim in either direction: read its setUp() before quoting a result, and do not treat its absence here as evidence that it is local, that it forks, or that it is unnecessary. Suites are added one area at a time, each with the run that produced its numbers.

deploys: all seven component factories in FusionFactoryStorageLib.FactoryAddresses
mutations: prank as owner to grant DAO_FEE_MANAGER_ROLE and MAINTENANCE_MANAGER_ROLE on the factory it just deployed

suites.proves: The checked-out FusionFactory source composes a complete vault from freshly deployed components, and its access control and validation behave as written.
suites.doesNotProve: Nothing about any deployed factory, its live configuration, or the components a real network holds.

mutations: prank as owner to grant DAO_FEE_MANAGER_ROLE and MAINTENANCE_MANAGER_ROLE

suites.doesNotProve: Which fee packages any deployed factory currently holds, or which caller they are keyed to on a live network.

suites.proves: That a scheduled fuse-manager operation on a vault created by this source can be cancelled, and who may cancel it.
suites.doesNotProve: The delays configured on any deployed vault; this fixture sets its own.

externalAddresses.role: unchanged Ethereum FusionFactory proxy under test
USDC underlying token metadata and vault asset

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, the unchanged candidate proxy can permissionlessly clone a complete USDC vault using fee package 0; returned components have code, the requested owner receives OWNER_ROLE and the deployed FeeManager matches the caller-effective package.
suites.doesNotProve: Current state after the pinned block, that another caller resolves to the same package, that the new private vault is configured as a strategy, or that any transaction should be broadcast.

prank as the new vault's own owner to grant roles and configure the market; the deployed factory and fuses are never upgraded, etched or granted anything
deal USDC to the test depositor (test-only funding) and warp past the vault's own redemption delay before redeeming (test-only time travel)

externalAddresses.role: unchanged Ethereum FusionFactory proxy that creates the vault
deployed ERC4626 supply fuse for market 100001, used unchanged
deployed ERC4626 balance fuse for market 100001, used unchanged
Steakhouse USDC MetaMorpho vault, the market's only substrate
USDC, the vault's underlying asset

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, a vault created by the unchanged factory can be configured for the catalogued ERC4626 market with the deployed fuses and then carry a full asset cycle: deposit, supply into Steakhouse USDC through ALPHA_ROLE, exit back and redeem, with total assets preserved within 1 USDC on 100000 and the 50% market limit enforced.
suites.doesNotProve: That the current source's Erc4626SupplyFuse interface is deployed (it is not — the deployed fuse takes (vault, amount) without slippage bounds), that yield accrues over time, that any other substrate, market or protocol works, or that a transaction should be broadcast.

mutations: prank as an unprivileged caller for one permissionless create() on the unchanged price feed factory; the created feed exists only on the ephemeral fork
prank as the price oracle middleware for one static read of the feed, because the feed asks msg.sender for the asset price

externalAddresses.role: unchanged ERC4626 price feed factory proxy under test
price oracle middleware the feed is created for and read as
Steakhouse USDC, the ERC4626 vault the feed prices
USDC, the vault's asset and the priced token

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, a permissionless caller can create an ERC4626 price feed through the unchanged deployed factory; the feed points at the requested vault, reports 18 decimals and returns a price that equals the value recomputed from convertToAssets and the middleware's USDC price to within 1 wei, while a non-ERC4626 address is rejected.
suites.doesNotProve: That the deployed implementation is the code in this checkout, that the feed behaves the same for other vaults or assets, that a feed registered in a vault's price manager is configured correctly, or that any transaction should be broadcast.

suites.proves: At Ethereum block 25937526, the unchanged wrapper factory creates a wrapper bound to the requested plasma vault with the same asset, the requested name, symbol, owner, fee accounts and fee percentages; configuration is restricted to the wrapper's own owner, and a zero vault or a fee above 100% is refused.
suites.doesNotProve: Anything about the whitelist wrapper variant, that deposits or withdrawals through the wrapper accrue correctly over time, that the deployed implementation is the code in this checkout, or that any transaction should be broadcast.
